questions.stem: Which of the following acts will always result in the total release of a compensated surety?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The creditor extends the principal debtor's time to pay by three weeks.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The creditor failed to disclose the debtor's bad credit rating to the surety.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The place of payment is changed to another state.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The principal debtor's obligation is partially released.

questions.explanation:
A suretyship is an arrangement in which a surety (cosigner or guarantor) promises a creditor that the surety will be responsible for a debt owed by a third party. A surety can be either compensated (paid to be a surety) or non-compensated (parents cosigning a child's student loan).

Because the obligation of the surety is to the creditor, the creditor owes the surety a fiduciary duty to act in its best interests and not increase the surety's risk of having to pay off the debt. A surety is released from its obligation if the creditor:

fails to disclose negative information the creditor has about the principal debtor.

changes the original agreement with the debtor in a way that materially increases the surety's risk of loss (having to pay the debt).

extends the due date for repayment by the principal debtor (a compensated surety is not released unless the extension materially increases their risk) ("The creditor extends the principal debtor's time to pay by three week…").

releases collateral that had secured the debt. If it is a partial release, then it releases the surety for the value of the collateral and is not a total release of the surety ("The principal debtor's obligation is partially released.").

releases the principal debtor from the obligation.

performance (payment) is tendered to the creditor, even if the creditor refuses a tender of payment from the principal debtor.

("The place of payment is changed to another state.") Changing the location for payment does not materially increase the surety's risk of having to pay off the debt, so the surety is not released from the obligation.
questions.explanationJa: 保証（suretyship）では、債権者は保証人のリスクを高めないよう配慮する義務を負う。そのため、債権者が主債務者に関する不利な情報を開示しなかった場合、保証人は保証債務から解放される。有償保証人の場合、支払期限の延長はリスクを著しく高めるときに限り解放事由となるため、3週間の延長だけでは常に解放されるとはいえない。担保の一部解放は、その価値の範囲で解放されるにとどまる。支払場所の変更は保証人のリスクを著しく高めないため、解放事由とならない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.1

questions.stem: Mars, Inc. manufactures and sells video screens on credit directly to wholesalers, retailers, and consumers. Mars can perfect its security interest in the video screens it sells without having to file a financing statement or take possession of the video screens if the sale is made to

choices.label: A
choices.text: Retailers for their inventory held for resale to consumers.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Wholesalers that sell to distributors for resale.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Consumers for use in their household.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Wholesalers that sell to buyers in the ordinary course of business.

questions.explanation:
Attachment and perfection of a security interest in collateral (PIG FAT)

Attachment

Occurs after all three

Property (collateral) "owned" by debtor (=has rights)

Interest in the collateral created by either

    Signed security agreement or

    Taking possession (writing not required)

Giving value to debtor (present or past)

Perfection

Occurs after any one of the three

Filing a financing statement

Automatic perfection (purchase money security interest, or PMSI)

Taking possession of collateral (writing not required)

An enforceable security interest allows a creditor to seize the collateral if the debtor defaults on the loan. However, to have this right, the creditor must properly attach and perfect the security interest.

There are three ways to perfect a security interest in a debtor's collateral (represented by FAT). A purchase money security interest (PMSI) is the only one that can be done without filing a financing statement or taking possession of the collateral.

Under the UCC, a PMSI automatically perfects when someone in the business of selling consumer goods (Mars, Inc.) sells those goods on credit to a consumer for use in their household. Attachment also occurs because all three elements (represented by PIG) are present in the credit-sale transaction.

("Retailers for their inventory held for resale to consumers." / "Wholesalers that sell to distributors for resale." / "Wholesalers that sell to buyers in the ordinary course of business.") A PMSI also applies in the business-to-business context for the sale of goods when the goods are purchased for inventory or equipment. However, in a business-to-business sale of goods, perfection of a PMSI is not automatic. The seller must file a financing statement with the appropriate state authority to perfect the PMSI.
questions.explanationJa: 担保権の対抗要件を備える（perfection）方法は、融資証書（financing statement）の登録、占有、自動的な具備の3つであり、登録も占有もせずに具備できるのは購入代金担保権（PMSI）による自動具備だけである。UCCでは、消費財を販売する事業者が家庭用に使う消費者に掛け売りした場合、PMSIは自動的に対抗要件を備える。一方、卸売業者や小売業者に在庫用として販売する事業者間取引では、PMSIは自動では具備されず、融資証書を登録する必要がある。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.2

questions.stem:
A party involuntarily petitioned into bankruptcy under the federal bankruptcy code who succeeds in having the petition dismissed may recover which of the following types of damages?
Costs to dismiss petition | Compensatory damages | Punitive damages

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: Yes | No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | Yes | Yes

questions.explanation:
An involuntary bankruptcy occurs when unsecured creditors file a petition to place a debtor in bankruptcy. The petition can be filed under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 or the reorganization provisions of Chapter 11. When an involuntary bankruptcy petition is filed by creditors, a court hearing date must be set before the petition is effective. This hearing gives the debtor the opportunity to contest the petition and have it dismissed by the court.

Creditors who file an involuntary bankruptcy petition against a debtor without meeting the requirements to do so will have their petition dismissed by the court. In addition, they may be liable for the costs the debtor incurred to have the petition dismissed (reasonable attorney fees). If a petition is filed in bad faith (dishonestly), a creditor may be liable for compensatory damages.
questions.explanationJa: 債権者が要件を満たさずに申し立てた非自発的破産の申立てが却下された場合、債権者は債務者が却下のために負担した費用（合理的な弁護士費用など）の賠償責任を負うことがある。さらに申立てが悪意（不誠実）によるものであれば、債権者は損害賠償の責任も負う。したがって却下に要した費用、補償的損害賠償、懲罰的損害賠償のいずれも回収し得る。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.3

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, a financing statement generally must contain

choices.label: A
choices.text: The signature of a witness to the execution of the financing statement.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The dollar amount of the consideration provided by the secured party.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The date the underlying debt will be paid.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The address of the debtor.

questions.explanation:
A proper financing statement is required to contain only:

a list or description of the collateral

the name and address of the debtor

the name and address of the creditor

("The signature of a witness to the execution of the financing statemen…" / "The dollar amount of the consideration provided by the secured party." / "The date the underlying debt will be paid.") A witness signature, dollar amount of the consideration, and the date the underlying debt is due are all optional items that can be included on the financing statement at the creditor's discretion. Most creditors don't include this information because they don't want it disclosed to the public.
questions.explanationJa: 適切な融資証書（financing statement）に記載が必要なのは、担保物の一覧または記述、債務者の名称と住所、債権者の名称と住所だけである。立会人の署名、担保権者が提供した対価の金額、被担保債務の返済期日はいずれも任意の記載事項である。これらは公開されるため、多くの債権者は記載しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.4

questions.stem: Which of the following types of debtor are not eligible for relief under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Individuals.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Limited Liability Companies.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Airlines.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Stockbrokers.

questions.explanation:
Chapter 11 bankruptcy is for debtors that seek reorganization rather than liquidation. Each debtor continues to operate its business while formulating a plan with creditors to repay a portion of the debt and discharge the remainder. The goal is to give the debtor a fresh start by putting it in a better financial position so it can operate profitably.

In general, individuals and all types of entities, regardless of type (corporations, limited liability companies) or industry, can file Chapter 11 bankruptcy ("Individuals." / "Limited Liability Companies." / "Airlines."). However, there are some limitations. Banks, savings and loans, insurance companies, and stockbrokers are prohibited from filing for relief under Chapter 11. The federal and state governmental agencies that regulate banks, savings and loans, and insurance companies have their own separate procedures for when these entities become insolvent. Stockbrokers can only file Chapter 7 bankruptcy.
questions.explanationJa: Chapter 11は清算ではなく再建を目的とする手続であり、債務者は事業を継続しながら債権者と返済計画を策定する。原則として個人、LLCなどあらゆる種類・業種の事業体が利用でき、航空会社も対象となる。しかし銀行、貯蓄貸付組合、保険会社、証券ブローカーはChapter 11を利用できない。証券ブローカーはChapter 7のみ申し立てることができる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.5

questions.stem:
On February 28, 20X1, Master, Inc. had total assets with a fair market value of $1,200,000 and total liabilities of $990,000. On January 15, 20X1, Master made a monthly installment note payment to Acme Distributors Corp., a creditor holding a properly perfected security interest in equipment having a fair market value greater than the balance due on the note. On March 15, 20X1, Master voluntarily filed a petition in bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. One year later, the equipment was sold for less than the balance due on the note to Acme.

Master's payment to Acme could

choices.label: A
choices.text: Be set aside as a preferential transfer because the fair market value of the collateral was greater than the installment note balance.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Be set aside as a preferential transfer unless Acme showed that Master was solvent on January 15, 20X1.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Not be set aside as a preferential transfer because Acme was oversecured.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not be set aside as a preferential transfer if Acme showed that Master was solvent on March 15, 20X1.

questions.explanation:
Choice "Not be set aside as a preferential transfer because Acme was oversecu…" (Correct): A payment is not considered preferential unless it provides the creditor with a larger amount than it would have received out of bankruptcy assets. A fully secured creditor has recourse to the collateral, so a payment to such a creditor would not be considered preferential.

Choice "Be set aside as a preferential transfer because the fair market value…" (Incorrect): The fact that the collateral is worth more than the note is the reason the payment is not a preferential transfer.

Choice "Be set aside as a preferential transfer unless Acme showed that Maste…" (Incorrect): Insolvency of the debtor at the time of transfer is one of the requirements of a preferential transfer, but is not sufficient by itself.

Choice "Not be set aside as a preferential transfer if Acme showed that Maste…" (Incorrect): Solvency as of the date of filing the petition is not relevant to determining whether a past transfer was preferential.
questions.explanationJa: 支払が偏頗行為（preferential transfer）として否認されるのは、その支払により債権者が破産財団から受け取れる額より多くを得る場合である。Acmeは担保物の公正価値が債務残高を上回る全額担保の債権者であり、もともと担保から回収できるため、支払を受けても多く得たことにはならない。したがって支払は偏頗行為として否認されない。支払時の債務者の支払不能は偏頗行為の要件の一つにすぎず、それだけでは否認できない。申立日時点の支払能力は判断に関係しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.6

questions.stem: When a principal debtor defaults and a surety pays the creditor the entire obligation, which of the following remedies is the surety's best method of collecting from the debtor?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Exoneration.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Contribution.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Subrogation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Attachment.

questions.explanation:
The surety typically is a cosigner or a guarantor.

In a surety transaction, subrogation is the legal assumption of the creditor's rights against the debtor after the surety pays the debtor's debt to the creditor. In effect, the surety assumes the role of the creditor and takes on the same rights the creditor had against the debtor. This is the best method available to a surety for collecting from the debtor.

("Exoneration.") Exoneration is the legal right of a surety to sue the debtor to compel payment to the creditor. For example, a surety might do this when the debtor has assets it can sell and use the proceeds to satisfy the debt but is reluctant to do so. Although this remedy is available to the surety, it does not involve the surety's collecting anything from the debtor.

("Contribution.") Contribution is a cosurety's legal right to obtain a recovery from another cosurety who did not help pay off the debt.

("Attachment.") Attachment is part of the process of creating a security interest. It is most often used by creditors, not sureties.
questions.explanationJa: 代位（subrogation）とは、保証人が主債務者の債務を弁済した後、債権者が主債務者に対して持っていた権利を引き継ぐことをいい、保証人が主債務者から回収する最善の手段である。免責請求（exoneration）は主債務者に債権者への弁済を強制する権利であり、保証人自身が回収するものではない。分担請求（contribution）は共同保証人の間で負担を求める権利である。設定（attachment）は担保権を成立させる手続であり、通常は債権者が用いる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.7

questions.stem: Edwards Corp. lent Lark $200,000. At Edwards' request, Lark entered into an agreement with Owen and Ward for them to act as compensated co-sureties on the loan in the amount of $200,000 each. If Edwards releases Ward without Owen's or Lark's consent and Lark later defaults, which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lark will be released for 50% of the loan balance.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Owen will be liable for the entire loan balance.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Owen will be liable for 50% of the loan balance.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Edwards' release of Ward will have no effect on Lark's and Owen's liability to Edwards.

questions.explanation:
Creditor's actions that release a surety

Increases risk

Fail to disclose negative information about debtor

Change original agreement

Extend due date (must be material for compensated surety)

Releases

Collateral (partial if only part of collateral release)

Debtor

Payment tendered

Accept or receive offer of performance (payment)

When there are two or more co-sureties, each is jointly and severally liable to the creditor.

A co-surety that pays more than its pro rata share of the debt has a right of contribution from the other surety or sureties. In addition, the creditor owes the surety a fiduciary duty to act in its best interests and not increase the surety's risk of having to pay off the debt.

In this scenario, the creditor's (Edwards Corp.) release of Ward (a cosurety) would be a breach of its fiduciary duty because it would increase Owen's (the other cosurety) risk on the loan. Owen would no longer have a right of contribution from Ward if Lark defaults and Owen has to pay the entire debt. To keep Owen in the same position as the original cosurety arrangement, Owen would have to be released from paying 50% of the loan balance if Lark defaults.

("Lark will be released for 50% of the loan balance.") Lark would still be obligated to pay the entire debt despite Ward's being released as a surety.

("Owen will be liable for the entire loan balance." / "Edwards' release of Ward will have no effect on Lark's and Owen's lia…")If Ward were released without Owen's consent, Owen would be liable for 50% of the debt and would no longer be liable for 100% of the debt.
questions.explanationJa: 共同保証人は債権者に対して連帯して責任を負い、自己の負担部分を超えて弁済した共同保証人は他の共同保証人に分担を求められる。債権者は保証人のリスクを高めない義務を負うため、Owenの同意なくWardを解放すると、OwenはWardへの分担請求権を失いリスクが高まる。そこでOwenを当初の立場に保つため、Owenは負担部分である貸付残高の50%について責任を免れ、残りの50%について責任を負う。主債務者のLarkは、Wardの解放後も債務全額の弁済義務を負う。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.8

questions.stem: On April 7, Smithco purchased industrial equipment from Equipco on credit and took possession of the equipment the same day. Equipco filed a financing statement covering the equipment on April 18. On April 10, Smithco borrowed funds from Loanco secured by all of Smithco's equipment. Loanco filed its financing statement on April 11. Twenty months later, Smithco defaulted on both loans. Equipco paid Collectionco $750 to foreclose on the equipment and sell it at auction. Which party will be paid first from the equipment sale proceeds?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Smithco.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Equipco.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Loanco.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Collectionco.

questions.explanation:
If the debt is secured by collateral, the secured creditor has a claim to the property and can foreclose on it (rightfully take it), sell it, and apply the proceeds to the unpaid debt.

The collateral sales proceeds must be distributed in the following order until the proceeds are depleted:

Selling expenses: These are the reasonable expenses incurred by any party (Collectionco) associated with foreclosing on and selling the collateral (attorney, sales broker, CPA).

Foreclosing (primary) creditor: Next, the proceeds are applied to the unpaid debt of the creditor that foreclosed on the collateral (Equipco) ("Equipco.").

Subordinate secured creditor(s): The proceeds are next applied to the debt of the creditor(s) who had a subordinate (lesser) security interest in the collateral (Loanco) ("Loanco.").

Debtor: Any remaining proceeds must be returned to the debtor (Smithco) ("Smithco.").
questions.explanationJa: 担保物の売却代金は、尽きるまで次の順序で配分される。まず担保物の差押え・売却に要した合理的な費用（弁護士・仲介業者・CPAの費用など）が支払われる。次に差押えを行った債権者、その次に劣後する担保権者、最後に残額があれば債務者に返還される。本問では売却を担当したCollectioncoの費用が最初に支払われ、その後Equipco、Loanco、Smithcoの順となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.9

questions.stem:
On February 28, 20X1, Master, Inc. had total assets with a fair market value of $1,200,000 and total liabilities of $990,000. On January 15, 20X1, Master made a monthly installment note payment to Acme Distributors Corp., a creditor holding a properly perfected security interest in equipment having a fair market value greater than the balance due on the note. On March 15, 20X1, Master voluntarily filed a petition in bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. One year later, the equipment was sold for less than the balance due on the note to Acme.

If a creditor challenged Master's right to file, the petition would be dismissed

choices.label: A
choices.text: If Master had less than 12 creditors at the time of filing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Unless Master can show that a reorganization under Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code would have been unsuccessful.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Unless Master can show that it is unable to pay its debts in the ordinary course of business or as they come due.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If Master is an insurance company.

questions.explanation:
Choice "If Master is an insurance company." (Correct): While a voluntary petition under Chapter 7 can normally be filed by any individual, partnership, or corporation, the law does not permit a Chapter 7 filing by banks or insurance companies.

Choice "If Master had less than 12 creditors at the time of filing." (Incorrect): The debtor may have any number of creditors when filing voluntarily under Chapter 7.

Choice "Unless Master can show that a reorganization under Chapter 11 of the…" (Incorrect): There is no need for a Chapter 7 debtor to first show that a Chapter 11 reorganization would have been unsuccessful.

Choice "Unless Master can show that it is unable to pay its debts in the ordi…" (Incorrect): The debtor need not be insolvent in order to file voluntarily under Chapter 7.
questions.explanationJa: Chapter 7の自発的申立ては、通常、個人・パートナーシップ・法人のいずれも行える。ただし銀行や保険会社はChapter 7を申し立てることができないため、Masterが保険会社であれば申立ては却下される。自発的申立てでは債権者の数に制限はなく、事前にChapter 11の再建が不成功であることを示す必要もない。また債務者が支払不能である必要もない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.10

questions.stem: Taso Corp. sells laptop computers to the public. Taso sold and delivered a laptop to Cara on credit. Cara gave Taso a purchase money security interest in the laptop by executing and delivering to Taso a promissory note for the purchase price and a security agreement covering the laptop. Cara purchased the laptop for personal use. Taso did not file a financing statement. Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, is Taso's security interest perfected?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No, because the laptop is a consumer good.

choices.label: B
choices.text: No, because Taso failed to file a financing statement.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Yes, because it was perfected at the time of attachment.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Yes, because Taso retained possession of the collateral.

questions.explanation:
A PMSI applies when someone in the business of selling consumer goods (merchant) sells those goods on credit to a consumer ("No, because the laptop is a consumer good."). Under UCC rules, perfection automatically occurs at the moment of sale. Attachment also occurs because all three required elements(PIG) are present in the credit sale transaction.

("No, because Taso failed to file a financing statement." / "Yes, because Taso retained possession of the collateral.") The effectiveness of a PMSI does not depend on the purchaser retaining ownership of the item purchased (as collateral). In addition, there is no requirement that a seller of consumer goods must file the financing statement. However, if the purchaser/debtor sells the consumer good to another good faith consumer, the new purchaser takes the property free of the automatic perfection. To close this "loophole," the original seller/creditor must file the financing statement within 20 days of attachment (the date of sale).
questions.explanationJa: 購入代金担保権（PMSI）は、消費財を販売する事業者が消費者に掛け売りした場合に成立し、UCCでは販売の時点で自動的に対抗要件を備える。担保権の設定（attachment）に必要な3要素もこの掛け売り取引で満たされるため、設定と同時に対抗要件が具備される。したがって、消費財であることは対抗要件を否定する理由にならない。また、融資証書の登録も売主による占有も要しない。ただし、購入者が別の善意の消費者に転売した場合、新たな購入者は自動具備の担保権の付かない物を取得する。この抜け穴を防ぐには、売主は融資証書を登録する必要がある。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.11

questions.stem: Under the federal bankruptcy code, which of the following rights or powers does a trustee in bankruptcy not have?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The power to prevail against a creditor with an unperfected security interest.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The power to require persons holding the debtor's property at the time the bankruptcy petition is filed to deliver the property to the trustee.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The right to use any grounds available to the debtor to obtain the return of the debtor's property.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The right to avoid any statutory liens against the debtor's property that were effective before the bankruptcy petition was filed.

questions.explanation:
Bankruptcy is a legal process whereby a debtor is relieved of debts and the claims of the debtor's creditors are satisfied in the fairest way possible. If a trustee is appointed, as in a Chapter 7 bankruptcy, the debtor's assets are turned over to the trustee and those assets become the bankruptcy estate. The trustee then liquidates (ie, sells) the bankruptcy estate assets and uses the proceeds to satisfy as many of the creditors' claims as possible.

A bankruptcy trustee is given broad powers to get as much of the debtor's property included in the bankruptcy estate as possible. In gathering the property, the trustee "steps into the shoes" of the debtor and is able to use any grounds that would have been available to the debtor to obtain a return of the debtor's property ("The right to use any grounds available to the debtor to obtain the re…").

When gathering any of the debtor's property that is subject to a security interest, the trustee has priority (can prevail) over a security interest that has not been perfected("The power to prevail against a creditor with an unperfected security…"). In addition, the trustee is able to force a creditor who holds the debtor's property as collateral to deliver the property into the bankruptcy estate ("The power to require persons holding the debtor's property at the tim…"). However, the trustee does not have priority over a creditor who has either a statutory lien or a perfected security interest that was in effect prior to the bankruptcy filing.
questions.explanationJa: 破産管財人は債務者の財産をできるだけ多く破産財団に取り込むための広い権限を持つ。具体的には、債務者が用いることのできたあらゆる根拠を使って財産の返還を求められる。また、対抗要件を備えていない担保権者には優先し、債務者の財産を保有する者に財団への引渡しを求めることもできる。しかし、破産申立て前に効力を生じていた法定先取特権や対抗要件を備えた担保権には優先しないため、それらを否認する権限はない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.12

questions.stem:
Which of the following conditions, if any, must a debtor meet to file a voluntary bankruptcy petition under Chapter 7 of the federal Bankruptcy Code?
Insolvency | Three or more creditors

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
In a voluntary bankruptcy, the debtor does not need to prove insolvency (liabilities exceed the fair market value of assets). The debtor's duty is to file the petition asking for debt relief. There is no requirement that the debtor have three or more creditors.

The reason debtors file voluntarily is that the court automatically enters an order of relief, which stops all creditors from pursuing claims directly (foreclosures and repossessions). When a petition is filed involuntarily by the creditors, a court hearing date must be set before the petition is effective, so the order of relief occurs later.

The involuntary bankruptcy requirements contain a requirement that involves three or more creditors. When the creditors file the petition, it must be signed by three or more creditors if there are 12 or more unsecured creditors filing the petition. Only one creditor needs to sign it if there are fewer than 12 unsecured creditors.
questions.explanationJa: Chapter 7の自発的申立てでは、債務者は支払不能（負債が資産の公正価値を上回る状態）を証明する必要はなく、債権者が3人以上いる必要もない。自発的に申し立てると直ちに救済命令が出され、債権者による取立てや差押えが止まる。「3人以上の債権者」は、債権者が申し立てる非自発的破産の要件であり、債権者が12人以上いる場合に3人以上の署名が必要となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.13

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, a secured party generally must comply with each of the following duties except

choices.label: A
choices.text: Filing or sending the debtor a termination statement when the debt is paid.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Confirming, at the debtor's request, the unpaid amount of the debt.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Using reasonable care in preserving any collateral in the secured party's possession.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Assigning the security interest to another party at the debtor's request.

questions.explanation:
A secured transaction occurs when a creditor (secured party) either lends money or extends credit to a debtor and obtains a security interest in the debtor's property (collateral) during the repayment period. An enforceable security interest allows the creditor to seize the collateral if the debtor defaults. During the time the debt remains outstanding, the creditor has certain responsibilities to the debtor.

If the creditor (bank) takes possession of the collateral (vehicle), it must take reasonable steps to preserve or secure it ("Using reasonable care in preserving any collateral in the secured par…"). When requested by the debtor, the creditor must confirm the unpaid amount of the loan ("Confirming, at the debtor's request, the unpaid amount of the debt."). Finally, when the debt is paid off, the creditor must file a termination statement with the appropriate government authority or send it to the debtor ("Filing or sending the debtor a termination statement when the debt is…"). The termination statement is a notice that the property which served as collateral is no longer subject to a security interest.

A secured creditor does not owe a debtor a duty to assign the security interest to another party at the debtor's request. However, a debtor could accomplish this by refinancing (paying off) the existing secured loan with a secured loan from another creditor (similar to refinancing a home mortgage).
questions.explanationJa: 担保権者は、債務が残っている間、債務者に対して一定の義務を負う。自ら占有する担保物は合理的な注意をもって保全し、債務者の求めがあれば未払残高を確認し、完済時には終了証書（termination statement）を登録するか債務者に送付しなければならない。しかし、債務者の求めに応じて担保権を他者に譲渡する義務はない。債務者がそれを望む場合は、他の債権者からの借換えで既存の担保付借入を完済することになる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.14

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, if a secured creditor rightfully repossesses and sells a debtor's collateral, which of the following obligations is the first to be paid from the proceeds of the sale?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The debt owed to any creditor with a subordinate security interest in the collateral.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The balance of the debt owed the primary secured creditor.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The reasonable expenses incurred by the sale.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The refund of the debtor's payments made prior to the date of the sale.

questions.explanation:
If the debt is secured by collateral, the secured creditor has a claim to the property and can foreclose on it (rightfully take it), sell it, and apply the proceeds to the unpaid debt.

The creditor must distribute the collateral sales proceeds in the following order until the proceeds are deleted.

Selling expenses: These are the reasonable expenses associated with foreclosing on and selling the collateral (fees paid to attorneys, sales brokers, CPAs).

Foreclosing (primary) creditor: Any remaining proceeds are applied to the unpaid debt of the creditor that foreclosed on the collateral ("The balance of the debt owed the primary secured creditor.").

Subordinate secured creditor(s): Any remaining proceeds are applied to the debt of the creditor(s) that had a subordinate (lesser) security interest in the collateral ("The debt owed to any creditor with a subordinate security interest in…").

Debtor: Any remaining proceeds must be returned to the debtor ("The refund of the debtor's payments made prior to the date of the sal…").

For example, assume Debtor owes $100,000 to Creditor A and $50,000 to Creditor B (a subordinate secured creditor). Both debts are secured by Debtor's inventory as collateral. Debtor defaults on the debt to Creditor A. Creditor A forecloses on the inventory and sells it for $175,000. The legal and accounting fees to foreclose on and sell the collateral are $14,000. The proceeds from the sale of the collateral will be distributed as follows:

Distribution amount | Remaining balance
Total proceeds |  | $175,000
Selling expenses (attorneys, CPA) | $ 14,000 | 161,000
Creditor A (primary) | 100,000 | 61,000
Creditor B (subordinate) | 50,000 | 11,000
Debtor | 11,000 | 0
questions.explanationJa: 担保権者が担保物を正当に差し押さえて売却した場合、その代金は尽きるまで次の順序で配分される。まず差押え・売却に要した合理的な費用（弁護士・仲介業者・CPAの費用など）、次に差し押さえた担保権者の残債務、その次に劣後する担保権者の債務、最後に残額があれば債務者に返還される。したがって最初に支払われるのは売却に要した合理的な費用である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.15

questions.stem:
Dart Inc., a closely held corporation, was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. Dart contested the petition.

Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, has defaulted on its mortgage loan payments, and owes back taxes to the IRS. The total cash value of Dart's bankruptcy estate after the sale of all assets and payment of administration expenses is $100,000.

Dart has the following creditors:

Fracon Bank is owed $75,000 principal and accrued interest on a mortgage loan secured by Dart's real property. The property was valued at and sold, in bankruptcy, for $70,000.

The IRS has a $12,000 recorded judgment for unpaid corporate income tax.

JOG Office Supplies has an unsecured claim of $500 that was timely filed.

Nanstar Electric Co. has an unsecured claim of $1,200 that was not timely filed.

Decoy Publications has a claim of $16,500, of which $2,000 is secured by Dart's inventory that was valued and sold, in bankruptcy, for $2,000. The claim was timely filed.

Which of the following events will follow the filing of the Chapter 7 involuntary petition?

Ⅰ.　A trustee will be appointed

Ⅱ.　A stay against creditor collection proceedings will go into effect

choices.label: A
choices.text: I only.

choices.label: B
choices.text: II only.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both I and II.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither I nor II.

questions.explanation: Once a valid petition in bankruptcy has been filed, a trustee will be appointed to administer the estate. In addition, a stay against creditor collection procedures will go into effect. Since bankruptcy law determines the amount each creditor will be entitled to, collection procedures become irrelevant.
questions.explanationJa: 有効な破産の申立てがなされると、破産財団を管理する管財人が選任される。また、債権者による取立て手続を停止する自動停止（automatic stay）も効力を生じる。各債権者が受け取れる額は破産法に基づいて決まるため、個別の取立て手続は意味を持たなくなる。したがって、管財人の選任と自動停止の発効は、いずれも申立て後に生じる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.16

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions article of the UCC, when does a security interest become enforceable?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A contract is executed between a debtor and a secured party under which the debtor gives the secured party rights in collateral if the debtor violates any of the terms contained in the contract.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The debtor and the secured party execute a security agreement describing the transfer of the collateral and, after doing so, the secured party files it with the requisite agency.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The debtor and the secured party execute a security agreement describing the transfer of collateral from seller to buyer and the secured party retains possession of the agreement.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The value has been given, the secured party receives a security agreement describing the collateral authenticated by the debtor, and the debtor has rights in the collateral.

questions.explanation:
Secured transactions involve a creditor either lending money or extending credit to a debtor and, in exchange, obtaining a security interest in the debtor's property (collateral). A creditor who obtains an enforceable security interest via a security agreement receives this right at the time the security agreement is executed (signed), not when the debtor violates the agreement (defaults) ("A contract is executed between a debtor and a secured party under whi…").

An enforceable security interest allows the creditor to seize the collateral if the debtor defaults. However, in order to have this right, the creditor must properly attach and perfect the security interest. To have proper attachment of a security interest, all the following must occur:

The debtor must own (have rights to) the collateral.

The creditor must create an interest in the collateral through a security agreement that is signed by the debtor and reasonably describes the collateral, or through possession (pawn shop).

The debtor must have received value from the secured party.

("The debtor and the secured party execute a security agreement describ…") Filing a financing statement is not what makes a security interest enforceable. Filing is done to alert the public, including other potential claimants, of the creditor's security interest in the collateral (via a security agreement).

("The debtor and the secured party execute a security agreement describ…") The security agreement does not have to describe the transfer of the collateral.
questions.explanationJa: 担保権が強制可能（enforceable）となるには、担保権の設定（attachment）が必要である。設定には、担保権者が価値（value）を与えていること、債務者が担保物に権利を持つこと、債務者が認証（署名）し担保物を合理的に記述した担保契約があること（または担保権者の占有）の3つがすべて必要である。権利は契約締結時に生じ、債務者の契約違反（債務不履行）時に生じるのではない。融資証書の登録は第三者に担保権を公示するための手続であり、強制可能性の要件ではない。また担保契約に担保物の移転を記載する必要もない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.17

questions.stem: Brown cosigned Royal's $50,000 note to State Bank. If Royal is later adjudicated mentally incompetent, what would be Brown's liability on the note?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Liable to pay State Bank on the due date of the note.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Liable to pay State Bank only if State Bank first seeks payment from Royal.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Not liable to pay State Bank because Royal's incompetency discharges Royal as a surety.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not liable to pay State Bank unless Brown was a compensated surety.

questions.explanation:
A suretyship is an arrangement where a person agrees to be answerable to a creditor for the debt of another person. There are two main types of surety:

Primary (cosigner): The creditor is permitted to treat the cosigner as the debtor and can demand payment without proof of default or contractual capacity by the principal debtor ("Not liable to pay State Bank because Royal's incompetency discharges…").

Secondary (guarantor): The creditor can only demand payment if the principal debtor has defaulted ("Liable to pay State Bank only if State Bank first seeks payment from…").

The behavior of the principal debtor is irrelevant when determining the liability of the surety. This applies even when the principal debtor lacks contractual capacity (mentally incompetent), is discharged in bankruptcy, or used fraud to induce the surety.

("Not liable to pay State Bank unless Brown was a compensated surety.") A surety's compensation, if any, is not a factor in determining the surety's liability for the debt. However, a compensated surety (bonding company) is relieved of liability if the creditor increases the surety's risk of loss by materially changing the debt terms.
questions.explanationJa: 連帯保証人（cosigner）のような第一次的保証人に対しては、債権者は主債務者の不履行や行為能力を証明せずに直接支払を求められる。主債務者の事情は保証人の責任の判断に影響しない。主債務者が行為無能力（精神的無能力）と判断された場合や破産で免責された場合でも、保証人の責任は残る。したがってBrownは手形の支払期日にState Bankへ支払う責任を負う。保証人が有償かどうかも責任の有無には関係しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.18

questions.stem: Unger owes a total of $100,000 to eight unsecured creditors and one fully secured creditor. Quincy is one of the unsecured creditors and is owed $25,000. Quincy has filed a petition against Unger under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the federal Bankruptcy Code. Unger has been unable to pay debts as they become due. Unger's liabilities exceed Unger's assets. Unger has filed papers opposing the bankruptcy petition. Which of the following statements regarding Quincy's petition is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It will be dismissed because the secured creditor failed to join in the filing of the petition.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It will be dismissed because three unsecured creditors must join in the filing of the petition.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It will be granted because Unger's liabilities exceed Unger's assets.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It will be granted because Unger is unable to pay Unger's debts as they become due.

questions.explanation:
When a creditor files an involuntary bankruptcy petition for a debtor, minimum requirements must be met for the petition to be approved by the court. First, the unsecured creditor or creditors who file the involuntary petition must show claims of at least $18,600 in the aggregate. The petition needs three signatures if there are 12 or more unsecured creditors filing the petition, and only one signature if there are fewer than 12 creditors ("It will be dismissed because three unsecured creditors must join in t…"). Secured creditors do not sign the petition ("It will be dismissed because the secured creditor failed to join in t…").

If the debtor challenges the involuntary bankruptcy petition, the creditor does not need to prove insolvency (the debtor's liabilities exceed the fair market value of its assets) ("It will be granted because Unger's liabilities exceed Unger's assets."). All the creditor must show the court is that the debtor is not paying debts as they become due.
questions.explanationJa: 非自発的破産の申立てでは、申し立てる無担保債権者の債権額が合計$18,600以上必要である。署名は、債権者が12人以上いれば3人以上、12人未満なら1人でよい。Ungerの無担保債権者は8人なので、$25,000の債権を持つQuincy1人で申し立てられる。担保権者が申立てに加わる必要もない。債務者が争った場合、債権者は支払不能（負債超過）を証明する必要はなく、債務者が期限の到来した債務を支払っていないことを示せばよい。したがって申立ては、Ungerが期限の来た債務を支払えないことを理由に認められる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.19

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, which of the following statements is correct regarding a security interest that has not attached?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is effective against the debtor, but not against third parties.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is effective against both the debtor and third parties.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It is effective against third parties with unsecured claims.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is not effective against either the debtor or third parties.

questions.explanation: A creditor that does not properly attach its security interest to the collateral is an unsecured creditor without a priority claim on the collateral ("It is effective against the debtor, but not against third parties." / "It is effective against both the debtor and third parties." / "It is effective against third parties with unsecured claims."). Being a secured creditor is better than being an unsecured creditor. For instance, a secured creditor can prevent a debtor from selling collateral to others. If the debtor sells the collateral anyway, the secured creditor can seize it from the purchaser. An unsecured creditor does not have these rights.
questions.explanationJa: 担保権の設定（attachment）が適切になされていない債権者は、担保物に優先権を持たない無担保債権者にすぎない。そのような担保権は、債務者に対しても第三者（無担保債権者を含む）に対しても効力を持たない。担保権者であれば、債務者による担保物の売却を阻止したり、売却された担保物を購入者から取り戻したりできるが、無担保債権者にはこうした権利がない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.20

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct with respect to the reorganization provisions of Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A trustee must always be appointed.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The debtor must be insolvent if the bankruptcy petition was filed voluntarily.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A reorganization plan may be filed by a creditor any time after the petition date.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The commencement of a bankruptcy case may be voluntary or involuntary.

questions.explanation:
Chapter 11 bankruptcy is for debtors seeking reorganization rather than liquidation. The goal of a Chapter 11 bankruptcy is to give the debtor a fresh start by better positioning the debtor to operate profitably. The major aspects of a Chapter 11 bankruptcy include the following:

Voluntary or involuntary: Chapter 11 bankruptcy can be voluntary or involuntary, and there is no solvency requirement ("The debtor must be insolvent if the bankruptcy petition was filed vol…"). If it is involuntary, specific creditor filing requirements apply.

Who can file: Individuals and most entities can file Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

Debtor in possession: The debtor operates the business while formulating a plan with creditors to restructure its debt (reorganization plan). The court and a committee of unsecured creditors must approve major decisions (major asset sales). A trustee may be appointed to operate the business, but it is not always required ("A trustee must always be appointed.").

Plan of reorganization: Generally, the debtor has up to 18 months to submit a reorganization plan before a creditor can submit one ("A reorganization plan may be filed by a creditor any time after the p…"). Once submitted, the plan must be approved by a vote of two-thirds of the dollar amount of all claims and one-half of the number of claims.

Court confirmation: The approved plan is submitted to the court for confirmation.

Release: After the plan is confirmed by the court, the restructured debtor is released from bankruptcy and begins operations under its new debt structure.
questions.explanationJa: Chapter 11は清算ではなく再建を目的とする手続であり、申立ては自発的にも非自発的にも行える。自発的申立てに支払不能の要件はない。原則として債務者自身が事業を継続しながら再建計画を策定し（DIP）、管財人の選任は必須ではない。また一定期間（最長18か月）は債務者のみが再建計画を提出でき、債権者は申立日以後いつでも計画を提出できるわけではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.21

questions.stem: Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, for which of the following types of collateral must a financing statement be filed in order to perfect a purchase money security interest?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Stock certificates.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Promissory notes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Personal jewelry.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Inventory.

questions.explanation:
A purchase money security interest (PMSI) is another way a security interest is perfected. A PMSI applies to situations where a business (eg, a merchant) is selling consumer goods on credit to a consumer ("Personal jewelry."). Under UCC rules, perfection automatically occurs at the moment of sale. The merchant does not need to file the financing statement, although most merchants do.

A PMSI also applies in the business-to-business context for the sale of goods where the goods are purchased for inventory or equipment. However, in a business-to-business sale of goods, perfection of the PMSI is not automatic. The seller must file the financing statement with the appropriate state authority in order to perfect the PMSI.

("Stock certificates." / "Promissory notes.") A PMSI does not apply to intangible property such as promissory notes and stocks. Due to the ease of their transfer, perfecting a security interest in such collateral is best done by taking possession of the certificates or documents representing the intangible property.
questions.explanationJa: 購入代金担保権（PMSI）は、事業者が消費者に消費財（個人用の宝飾品など）を掛け売りした場合には、販売時に自動的に対抗要件を備える。一方、在庫や設備として購入される事業者間の物品販売にもPMSIは適用されるが、この場合の対抗要件は自動では具備されない。売主は所定の州機関に融資証書を登録する必要があり、在庫はこれに当たる。株券や約束手形にはPMSIは適用されず、これらは証書の占有によって対抗要件を備えるのが適切である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.22

questions.stem: Under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the federal Bankruptcy Code, which of the following statements applies to a person who has voluntarily filed for and received a discharge in bankruptcy?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The person will be discharged from all debts.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The person can obtain another Chapter 7 bankruptcy discharge in bankruptcy after three years have elapsed from the date of the prior filing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The person must surrender to the bankruptcy trustee amounts received as an inheritance if the receipt occurs within 180 days after filing the bankruptcy petition.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The person is precluded from owning or operating a similar business for two years.

questions.explanation:
As part of the process, the debtor turns over all assets owned at the time the bankruptcy petition is filed. In addition, the debtor must surrender certain property received within 180 days after the petition is filed. This property includes:

Inheritances

Life insurance proceeds

Divorce property settlements

("The person will be discharged from all debts.") Under the Bankruptcy Code, certain types of debt can never be discharged (alimony, child support).

("The person can obtain another Chapter 7 bankruptcy discharge in bankr…") The time allowed between Chapter 7 bankruptcy filings is eight years (not three years).

("The person is precluded from owning or operating a similar business f…") There are no provisions in the Bankruptcy Code precluding a discharged debtor from owning or operating a business similar to the one involved in the bankruptcy.
questions.explanationJa: Chapter 7では、債務者は申立て時に所有するすべての財産を引き渡すほか、申立て後180日以内に取得した一定の財産も引き渡さなければならない。これには相続財産、生命保険金、離婚に伴う財産分与が含まれる。扶養料や養育費など、免責されない債務もあるため、すべての債務が免責されるわけではない。再度Chapter 7の免責を受けるには8年の間隔が必要であり、3年ではない。また、免責後に同種の事業を所有・運営することを禁じる規定はない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Bankruptcy Q.23

questions.stem: On April 1, Roe borrowed $100,000 from Jet to pay Roe's business expenses. On June 15, Roe gave Jet a signed security agreement and financing statement covering Roe's inventory. Jet immediately filed the financing statement. On July 1, Roe filed for bankruptcy. Under the federal Bankruptcy Code, can Roe's trustee in bankruptcy set aside Jet's security interest in Roe's inventory?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes, because a security agreement may only cover goods actually purchased with the borrowed funds.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes, because Roe giving the security interest to Jet created a voidable preference.

choices.label: C
choices.text: No, because the security interest was perfected before Roe filed for bankruptcy.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No, because the loan proceeds were used for Roe's business.

questions.explanation:
Choice "Yes, because Roe giving the security interest to Jet created a voidab…" (Correct): Roe's giving the security interest to Jet at a time after the funds were originally borrowed provides Jet with collateral that it did not have on the antecedent debt, thus giving the security interest constitutes a preferential transfer of property that can be avoided by the trustee because it occurred within 90 days prior to the date of Roe's bankruptcy petition.

Choice "Yes, because a security agreement may only cover goods actually purch…" (Incorrect): A security agreement may cover goods in addition to those actually purchased with the borrowed funds; so this is not a reason why the trustee may set aside Jet's security interest in Roe's inventory.

Choice "No, because the security interest was perfected before Roe filed for…" (Incorrect): The trustee has the power to avoid preferential transfers that occurred within 90 days of filing the bankruptcy petition.

Choice "No, because the loan proceeds were used for Roe's business." (Incorrect): The fact that the loan proceeds were used for Roe's business does not prevent the trustee from avoiding a preferential transfer.
questions.explanationJa: Roeが4月1日の借入後、6月15日に担保権を与えたことは、既存の債務に対してJetに新たな担保を与える行為である。この担保権の付与は、破産申立て（7月1日）前90日以内に行われているため、管財人が否認できる偏頗行為に当たる。破産申立て前に対抗要件を備えていても、90日以内の偏頗行為は否認できる。担保契約は借入金で購入した物品以外も対象にできる。借入金を事業に使ったことも否認を妨げない。
